comment: Levels as one continuous map (LevelPlan.cs, in the manner of Minecraft Dungeons). mainZones: zones on the main path, start and boss included (the one before the boss is the sub-boss); branches: side branches off the middle of the main path, branchLength zones each, ending in the challenge and rest zones; loops: a branch's end joined back to a nearby zone of the main path; monsterHouse: combat zones turned into monster houses; gap: tiles of path between two zones' edges (min, max); turn: degrees the main path may turn at each zone; zoneScale: zone size from its room's size (rooms.json); pathWidth: tiles (min, max), varying along the path; wiggle: tiles a path strays from the straight line; border: tiles of wall around the outermost zones. Natural zones get an irregular outline, built ones (ring, cross, maze, bars plans) keep their rectangle. pocketChance / pocketEvery / pocketRadius: recesses on the side of the paths (chance every so many tiles, radius in tiles).
